metadata.description: Four tested skills for Claude Code: mimi (project memory), vera (pre-push bug finding and fixing), scrappy (web lookups that return a digest, not a dump) and pixi (distinctive frontends from real design references).

plugins.name: mimi
plugins.description: Project memory for coding agents that keeps only what the code cannot tell them: a mimi/ folder with state, issues, decisions and topic notes, loaded every session.

plugins.name: vera
plugins.description: Pre-push verification: 3 adversaries on 3 models try to break the change with runnable repros, each finding is confirmed, patched with its repro as the test, and re-attacked.

plugins.name: scrappy
plugins.description: Web and social lookups through the scrappy MCP server, routed through a summarising agent so only a short digest with source URLs reaches the main conversation.

plugins.name: pixi
plugins.description: Builds a distinctive landing page or marketing site from a real site screenshot reference instead of the default model look.
